objective: develop a grouped additive pathogenicity model whose logit is the intercept plus one inspectable scalar contribution from each biological evidence group

development_data_policy.validation_access: prohibited during implementation, debugging, hyperparameter selection and methodological decisions
development_data_policy.test_access: prohibited until one final architecture has been selected after validation

preprocessing.fit_scope: within each fold using fold-training rows only
preprocessing.binary_features: retain governed zero, one and missing meanings; impute missing values fold-locally only when required by the implementation

fixed_baseline_first.purpose: verify the shared data, preprocessing, fold, prediction and metric pipeline before grouped-additive training

grouped_additive_definition.equation: logit(p_i) = beta_0 + F_conservation(x_i) + F_gene_constraint(x_i) + F_amino_acid(x_i) + F_protein_context(x_i)
grouped_additive_definition.group_output: one scalar logit contribution per evidence group
grouped_additive_definition.required_faithfulness_identity: intercept plus saved group contributions must reconstruct the saved pre-sigmoid logit within numerical tolerance

registered_population_sensitivity.global_frequency_feature: excluded because it added no stable value after maximum-population AF
registered_population_sensitivity.coverage_control: frequency-observed versus unavailable indicator used only as a diagnostic

implementation_search_boundary.per_group_subnetwork: feed-forward network ending in one scalar output
implementation_search_boundary.search_rule: use a documented compact search selected by training-only gene-grouped cross-validation; do not expand the search after validation is accessed

training_and_threshold_policy.class_weighting: none in the balanced primary training cohort unless a fold-level safeguard is triggered and documented
training_and_threshold_policy.final_threshold: select once from pooled training out-of-fold predictions after hyperparameters are chosen; freeze before validation
training_and_threshold_policy.final_training_epochs: use the median best epoch from the five selected cross-validation fits
training_and_threshold_policy.calibration: evaluate raw probabilities; no post-hoc calibration in the primary candidate unless a separate training-only amendment is registered

reported_metrics.uncertainty: paired gene-level bootstrap where formal model differences are reported

required_automated_checks: input hashes match the frozen configuration
the primary feature list contains exactly 47 unique predictors
each predictor belongs to exactly one evidence group
GERP++, population fields, composite predictors, identifiers and labels are rejected as predictors
blank or duplicate variant keys fail
fold train and holdout genes do not overlap
preprocessing is fitted on fold-training rows only
saved group contributions reconstruct each saved logit
identical seeds reproduce predictions within documented numerical tolerance
dataset and split checksums remain unchanged
amendment_rule: any change after this freeze must be documented in a numbered protocol amendment created before the affected validation or test outcomes are accessed
